incident_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.

result.scene_summary: A house is on fire with flames visible through windows and doors, and the roof is burning. Smoke rises from the fire. The house has a porch and surrounding vegetation.

observations.description: Large flames engulfing the roof and interior of the house, visible through windows and doors.
Smoke rising from the burning house, particularly around the roof area.
Roof is damaged and burning; porch columns and siding show fire damage.
House with siding, windows, porch, and a chimney visible in the background.
Trees visible in the background behind the house.
Debris and damaged wood panels lying on the ground near the house.
